dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「朝ですよ……」
dialogues.en: "You will be late for school......"
dialogues.text: "You will be late for school......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「その……起きて下さい……」
ゆさゆさ。ゆさゆさ。
dialogues.en: Shake, shake. Shake, shake.
dialogues.text: Shake, shake. Shake, shake.

dialogues.jp: 「あと５分……あと５分したら起きるから……」
dialogues.en: "5 more minutes...... Give me 5 more minutes......"
dialogues.text: "5 more minutes...... Give me 5 more minutes......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「えと……５分したら……起きてくれるんです
　ね？」
dialogues.en: "You will wake up in...... 5 minutes?"
dialogues.text: "You will wake up in...... 5 minutes?"

dialogues.jp:
眠気を追い出す揺れが止まった。簡単に引き下
がるなんて、変だな。
dialogues.en:
The shaking that was trying to shake off my sleepiness
stops. It's strange that she gave up so easily.
dialogues.text:
The shaking that was trying to shake off my sleepiness
stops. It's strange that she gave up so easily.

dialogues.jp:
いつもの音夢なら、５秒と言っても却下してく
るはずなのだが……。
dialogues.en:
Usually Nemu will never let me have the 5 more minutes I
want.
dialogues.text:
Usually Nemu will never let me have the 5 more minutes I
want.

dialogues.jp:
そして、数分をめぐって、骨肉のバトルが展開
されるはずなのだが……。
dialogues.en:
And then, we usually have a few minutes of battle
afterwards......
dialogues.text:
And then, we usually have a few minutes of battle
afterwards......

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あの……まだ、５分経ってませんけれど……」
dialogues.en: "Ah...... it's not 5 minutes yet......"
dialogues.text: "Ah...... it's not 5 minutes yet......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「いやあ、やっぱ起きた方がいいかなと思って」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, but I thought I should wake up anyway."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, but I thought I should wake up anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「おはよ、頼子さん」
dialogues.en: "Good morning, Yoriko-san."
dialogues.text: "Good morning, Yoriko-san."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、はい、おはようございます……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, yes. Good morning......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, yes. Good morning......"

dialogues.jp: 軽く会釈をして、頼子さんは部屋を出ていった。
dialogues.en: She bows and walks out of my room.
dialogues.text: She bows and walks out of my room.

dialogues.jp: 「さて……と」
さくさくっと、学生服に着替えていく。
dialogues.en: I quickly change into my school uniform.
dialogues.text: I quickly change into my school uniform.

dialogues.jp:
「にしても、また音夢と間違えそうになったな。
　危なかった……」
dialogues.en:
"I was about to call her Nemu by mistake, again. That was
close......"
dialogues.text:
"I was about to call her Nemu by mistake, again. That was
close......"

dialogues.jp:
頭がぼんやりしていると、ついつい１０年来の
習性が顔を出す。気をつけないと。
dialogues.en:
When I'm half asleep, the response I've been accustomed to
giving for 10 years comes out. I've to be careful...
dialogues.text:
When I'm half asleep, the response I've been accustomed to
giving for 10 years comes out. I've to be careful...

dialogues.jp: 「おはよー」
dialogues.en: "Good morning!"
dialogues.text: "Good morning!"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「おはようございます」
dialogues.en: "Good morning."
dialogues.text: "Good morning."

dialogues.jp:
部屋に一歩入った途端、その光景に半歩退いた。
テーブルの上には、あのでかい鍋が。
dialogues.en:
As I take one step into the living room and look at the
table, I step back. The big pot's there on the table.
dialogues.text:
As I take one step into the living room and look at the
table, I step back. The big pot's there on the table.

dialogues.jp:
俺の視線につられたのか、頼子さんも鍋に目を
向けた。
dialogues.en: She looks at me looking at the pot and she looks at it, too.
dialogues.text: She looks at me looking at the pot and she looks at it, too.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あの……まだ、たくさん残ってます……」
dialogues.en: "Ah...... we still have a lot left......"
dialogues.text: "Ah...... we still have a lot left......"

dialogues.jp: 何ともしょんぼりした顔でそう告げた。
dialogues.en: She says sadly.
dialogues.text: She says sadly.

dialogues.jp: 「ああ、うん。だろうね」
dialogues.en: "Oh, yes. We do."
dialogues.text: "Oh, yes. We do."

dialogues.jp:
ふたりの視線を引きつける力がある以上、その
質量はなかなかのものだろう。
dialogues.en:
The amount of curry in the pot is so much that it easily
catches two people's eyes and doesn't let them go.
dialogues.text:
The amount of curry in the pot is so much that it easily
catches two people's eyes and doesn't let them go.

dialogues.jp:
「まあ、嫌いじゃないし、俺は朝からでも問題
　なくイケルけど」
dialogues.en: "I like curry, so I can eat it in a morning."
dialogues.text: "I like curry, so I can eat it in a morning."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、それじゃ温めますね……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, then I will warm it up......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, then I will warm it up......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「鍋は俺が運ぶよ」
dialogues.en: "I'll carry the pot for you."
dialogues.text: "I'll carry the pot for you."

dialogues.jp:
鍋の形に両腕を広げた頼子さんを、手で押しと
どめる。
dialogues.en: She was about to lift the pot but I push her away from it.
dialogues.text: She was about to lift the pot but I push her away from it.

dialogues.jp: 「よっと……お？」
dialogues.en: "Okay...... oh?"
dialogues.text: "Okay...... oh?"

dialogues.en: (It's heavy......)
dialogues.text: (It's heavy......)

dialogues.jp: ふらふらと台所に向かいつつ思った。
dialogues.en: I totter toward the kitchen.
dialogues.text: I totter toward the kitchen.

dialogues.jp:
二人で食べきるのに、いったい何日かかるんだ
ろうな……。
dialogues.en: How many days do we have to eat this for......?
dialogues.text: How many days do we have to eat this for......?

dialogues.jp: 「いただきま〜す」
dialogues.en: "Let's eat!"
dialogues.text: "Let's eat!"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「いただきます……」
dialogues.en: "Yes, let's......"
dialogues.text: "Yes, let's......"

dialogues.jp: カレーを口に含み、二人、顔を見合わせる。
dialogues.en:
We both take our first mouthful of curry and look at each
other.
dialogues.text:
We both take our first mouthful of curry and look at each
other.

dialogues.jp: 「何か……昨日より美味しくない？」
dialogues.en: "Don't you think...... it tastes better than last night?"
dialogues.text: "Don't you think...... it tastes better than last night?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、は、はい……私もそう思いました……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, y-yes...... I think so too......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, y-yes...... I think so too......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「へえ、カレーって、日を置くと旨くなるって
　ほんとだったんだな」
dialogues.en:
"Wow, it's true that the curry tastes better when you let it
sleep a night."
dialogues.text:
"Wow, it's true that the curry tastes better when you let it
sleep a night."

dialogues.jp:
噂には聞いていたが、まさかここまでとは。
思わず、妖精さんの存在を疑ってしまうぞ。
dialogues.en:
I'd heard it as a rumor before, but I'm surprised that it's
so true. That makes me think that I should probably believe
elves exist too...
dialogues.text:
I'd heard it as a rumor before, but I'm surprised that it's
so true. That makes me think that I should probably believe
elves exist too...

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「カレーというのは、そういうものなのでしょ
　うか？」
dialogues.en: "Do any kind of curries get this tasty after a day......?"
dialogues.text: "Do any kind of curries get this tasty after a day......?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「どうだろ？　俺も、まともなカレーを食べる
　なんて、久しぶりだしな……」
dialogues.en:
"I'm not sure. I haven't had real curry for a long
time......"
dialogues.text:
"I'm not sure. I haven't had real curry for a long
time......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「レトルトカレーじゃ、作り置きを食べる、な
　んて状況になるはずないからね」
dialogues.en:
"I always eat retort curry, so I don't meet situations to
let it sit a day, you know."
dialogues.text:
"I always eat retort curry, so I don't meet situations to
let it sit a day, you know."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「あの……そういうのばかり、食べていたんで
　すか……？」
dialogues.en:
"Ah...... so you have been eating those retort and frozen
foods......?"
dialogues.text:
"Ah...... so you have been eating those retort and frozen
foods......?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、まあね。まともに料理する奴が、家の
　中に居なかったし……」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah, I have. There was no one who could cook in this
house......"
dialogues.text:
"Yeah, I have. There was no one who could cook in this
house......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あの……ご両親は？」
dialogues.en: "Ah, what about your parents?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, what about your parents?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、ふたりとも海外。働いてるんだわ」
dialogues.en: "They're working overseas now."
dialogues.text: "They're working overseas now."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "What...?"
dialogues.text: "What...?"

dialogues.jp:
余程驚きだったのか、スプーン片手に固まって
しまった。ゴルゴンにでもなった気分。
dialogues.en:
She looks very surprised, and stops moving with a spoon in
her hand.
dialogues.text:
She looks very surprised, and stops moving with a spoon in
her hand.

dialogues.jp: 「そんなに意外かな？」
dialogues.en: "Is it so abnormal to have parents working overseas?"
dialogues.text: "Is it so abnormal to have parents working overseas?"

dialogues.jp: スプーンを静かに置き、こくりと頷いた。
dialogues.en: She puts down her spoon quietly and nods.
dialogues.text: She puts down her spoon quietly and nods.

dialogues.jp:
「そう？　ま、確かに、どこぞのドラマみたい
　ではあるけれど」
dialogues.en:
"Really? I mean, it does sound like a family in one of those
crazy complicated-story dramas."
dialogues.text:
"Really? I mean, it does sound like a family in one of those
crazy complicated-story dramas."

dialogues.jp:
血の繋がらない妹も居るしな。これで幼なじみ
が朝起こしに来てくれたら完璧だ。
dialogues.en:
Yeah, I have a step-sister and if a childhood friend of mine
comes to my room to wake me up in the morning, it does
really sound like a drama.
dialogues.text:
Yeah, I have a step-sister and if a childhood friend of mine
comes to my room to wake me up in the morning, it does
really sound like a drama.

dialogues.jp:
「まあ、最初は寂しいような気もしたけどね。
　でも、すぐに慣れたし」
dialogues.en: "I was a little bit sad at first but I'm used to it now."
dialogues.text: "I was a little bit sad at first but I'm used to it now."

dialogues.jp:
それに俺の場合、連絡を着けたければいつだっ
て着けられる。生きて、この世に居るのは確か
なのだから。
dialogues.en:
And if I want, I can call them any time. They're alive and
living in this world for sure.
dialogues.text:
And if I want, I can call them any time. They're alive and
living in this world for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「そんな……」

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「そんなもの……でしょうか……？」
dialogues.en: "But... is that as easy as you say......?"
dialogues.text: "But... is that as easy as you say......?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「だと思うよ？」
dialogues.en: "I think so."
dialogues.text: "I think so."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「そう……ですか」
dialogues.en: "If you say so......"
dialogues.text: "If you say so......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: （どうしたんだろうな……？）
dialogues.en: (What's the matter with her......?)
dialogues.text: (What's the matter with her......?)

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: （あ、もしかして……）
dialogues.en: (Oh, maybe......)
dialogues.text: (Oh, maybe......)

dialogues.jp:
猫をやっていた時の、飼い主でも思いだしてい
るんだろうか？
dialogues.en: Maybe she misses her owner from when she used to be a cat.
dialogues.text: Maybe she misses her owner from when she used to be a cat.

dialogues.jp: あの夢が、カレーの湯気の中に浮かび上がる。
dialogues.en:
The dream comes back up to my mind like steam rising from
the curry.
dialogues.text:
The dream comes back up to my mind like steam rising from
the curry.

dialogues.jp:
猫に向かって、“頼子”と語りかけていた、お
嬢様然とした少女。
dialogues.en:
There was a rich girl who was talking to a cat, calling it
'Yoriko'.
dialogues.text:
There was a rich girl who was talking to a cat, calling it
'Yoriko'.

dialogues.jp:
かったるい事になりそうで、｛あ／敢｝えて意識から締
め出していたのだが……。
dialogues.en:
I have been trying to shut the dream out from my mind
because I thought it would only bring trouble, but......
dialogues.text:
I have been trying to shut the dream out from my mind
because I thought it would only bring trouble, but......

dialogues.jp:
あの少女が見ていた人物は、もしかして俺なの
だろうか？
dialogues.en: Was it me the girl was watching from the window?
dialogues.text: Was it me the girl was watching from the window?

dialogues.jp:
与ひょうとつうなら、話は単純で、しかも美し
かったのに。
dialogues.en:
If it was a crane and I was the nice guy from The Grateful
Crane, the story would have been more simple and beautiful.
dialogues.text:
If it was a crane and I was the nice guy from The Grateful
Crane, the story would have been more simple and beautiful.

dialogues.jp:
招き猫だとか何だとかが絡んでくるとなると、
これは……。
dialogues.en:
But when it's a beckoning cat and me as... whatever I am,
what's gonna happen?
dialogues.text:
But when it's a beckoning cat and me as... whatever I am,
what's gonna happen?

dialogues.jp:
（初音島に、黄色いリボンの女の子は、何人い
　るんだろうな……？）
dialogues.en:
(How many girls with a yellow ribbon are there in Hatsune
Island?)
dialogues.text:
(How many girls with a yellow ribbon are there in Hatsune
Island?)

dialogues.jp:
それが多い事を願いつつ、機械的にスプーンを
口に運ぶ俺が居るのだった。
dialogues.en:
Hoping there are a lot, I automatically keep lifting the
spoon to my mouth.
dialogues.text:
Hoping there are a lot, I automatically keep lifting the
spoon to my mouth.

dialogues.jp: ◆黄色いリボンの女の子◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp:
朝、頼子さんに起こしてもらい、彼女と一緒に
朝食を食べる。

俺と話している途中で、前の飼い主のことでも
思い出したのか、切なそうな表情を見せる頼子
さん。
dialogues.en: "Good morning......"
dialogues.text: "Good morning......"

dialogues.jp:
俺はふと思い至った。前に見せられたあの少女
の夢、あの少女が夢見ていた人物はもしかして
俺なのだろうか？
dialogues.en: "Please...... wake up......"
dialogues.text: "Please...... wake up......"

dialogues.jp:
初音島に黄色いリボンの女の子が多いことを切
に願った。
dialogues.en: "Zzz, zzz......"
dialogues.text: "Zzz, zzz......"
